title: Texture, light and colour.
excerpt: The same colour can feel entirely different on another texture. Pay attention to small changes in light when choosing a fabric.
bodyMdx: The same colour can feel entirely different on another texture. Pay attention to small changes in light when choosing a fabric.
Examine your favourite fabric near a window. Notice how its colour changes between morning and evening.
Consider wood, wall colour and fabric side by side. Harmony does not always mean matching shades. It can come from the way different surfaces complement each other.
